items.prompt:
Use case: structural correction and style-transfer. One square illustration for 飞身劈.
Image 1 is the NAI draft: controls the cropped anonymous airborne warrior, diagonal downward sword, blue-gray/burgundy colored background and readable drawing. Image 2 is the old card: ACTION/ANATOMY reference only, especially two hands on one short hilt, nearer boot sole larger toward viewer, tucked knees, low camera and sword thrusting down-right. Do not copy its white backdrop or scattered painted texture. Image 3 is revised 摸索: STYLE PRINCIPLE reference only, clearly closed contours and structural lines first, grouped colors inside forms and quiet background; no lantern/cards.
Extreme low-camera close view of an anonymous adult martial warrior leaping into a downward two-handed cleave. Head and face completely above/outside the upper-left frame. Connected shoulders/arms, waist and TWO bent knees are visible; the nearer black boot sole points toward viewer at lower-left, larger than the smaller farther boot behind. Both hands visibly wrap the SAME SHORT SWORD HILT at upper-left, one above the other, anatomically joined to wrapped wrists and sleeves; no single hand, extra fingers or merged wrist. ONE broad straight steel sword runs continuously from guard toward lower-right, widening slightly in perspective and tapering into ONE pointed tip near the lower-right dark abstract target plane. Sword tip meeting this plane has one short ivory cut accent and tiny dark burgundy chip, no gore. Force comes from torso leaning behind grip and diagonally descending blade; short dark tunic hem and belt tail flick back/up, reinforcing airborne motion. Plain charcoal short tunic, gray trousers, black boots/gloves, ivory wrist wraps. No named hero identity, face, ponytail, goggles, cape or ornate armor.
Draw first with confident dark COLORED CONTOUR LINES of varied thickness/pressure, CLOSED connected silhouettes, selective internal structure marks: knuckles and grip, blade ridge/edges, elbow fold, knees, ankle/sole and clothing seams. Lines explain real anatomy and overlap. Broad matte color and grouped HARD shadows stay INSIDE these drawn forms, several restrained midtone turns and a few visible directional strokes inside the cloth/steel, not random smeared patches crossing contours. Cloth has principal broad folds with sparse tapered crease lines, not many equally dark wrinkle loops. Sword has coherent cool-gray planes and one restrained pale edge highlight; steel outlined cleanly but organically, not glossy photography. Boots have clear big sole volume with only a few tread bars. Keep selective handmade painted finish; neither uniform vector tracing nor all-over rough texture. Remove scratchy doubled sketch lines from the draft, preserve expressive line rhythm.
Background remains muted BLUE-GRAY and dark BURGUNDY, a broad diagonal color transition following the action. Quiet large areas, NO white/cream blank backdrop, no scattered brush carpet, landscape or rocks. No sparks, huge light beams, extra blades, disconnected limbs, text, frame, watermark or UI.
